title: Driver Incentive Terms, Definitions: The Locked Guarantee Amount
content:
**Definition.** For an earnings guarantee opt-in under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro**, the locked guarantee is the guaranteed amount stated on the upcoming earnings guarantee offer, unchanged; the upcoming earnings guarantee offer is the earnings guarantee offer with the latest window start on the driver's earnings account. The locked guarantee is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Source record.** The guaranteed amount is read from the offer record itself, as issued to the driver's account.

**Worked figures on hypothetical offers.**

| Earnings guarantee offers on the account (window start, guaranteed amount) | Upcoming offer | Locked guarantee |
|---|---|---|
| 3 March, 180.00; 10 March, 220.00 | The 10 March offer | 220.00 |
| 17 March, 150.00 | The 17 March offer | 150.00 |
| 24 March, 199.995 (an unrounded hypothetical figure) | The 24 March offer | 200.00 (half up to the cent) |

**Reading of the definition.** An earlier guarantee offer on the account, whatever its amount, is not the upcoming offer and does not set the locked guarantee.
